name: Mister Spex SE
summary: Mister Spex SE, an optical products retailer headquartered in Berlin, Germany, was established in 2007. The company offers a comprehensive range of eyewear, encompassing prescription spectacles, sunglasses, and contact lenses, to customers across ten European nations: Germany, Austria, Finland, France, the Netherlands, Norway, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom. Its product portfolio features items under its proprietary labels, independent brands, and a selection of premium and luxury designer eyewear. Mister Spex reaches its clientele through its online platforms, a network of affiliated opticians, and approximately 48 physical retail outlets, primarily situated in Germany, Austria, and Sweden.
